name: OpenAPI & REST Contract Linter
description: Validates REST API designs and OpenAPI 3.x specifications against industry best practices: RFC 7807 problem details, idempotent verbs, pagination standards, and consistent kebab-case/camelCase URL casing.

specPathOrContent.description: Path to openapi.json/yaml file or raw JSON/YAML specification content.

enforceRfc7807Errors.description: Require standardized RFC 7807 (ProblemDetails) for 4xx and 5xx responses.
